notes.subject: איש באחיהו ידבקו
notes.rationale: Targum/Revised Version: 'each is joined to its brother' (Leviathan's scales); KJV reads 'his hope is in vain' — this verse describes Leviathan's scales, not man's courage

notes.subject: אחיהו
notes.rationale: 'mũrũ wa nyina wake' is circumlocution; Gĩkũyũ rĩngĩ nĩ 'mũrũ-wa-nyina', the literal 'brother' describing scales clinging side-by-side

notes.subject: ידבקו / יתלכדו / יתפרדו
notes.rationale: Three verbs of clinging and separation in a chain — cling, seize, not-separate — the tightness is the rhetoric

translation: Mũndũ na mũrũ wa nyina wake nĩmahota kũratwarũka hamwe; magwatĩrĩka makĩhũra ⟨kĩndũ⟩ gĩa kũnyitana, na matirĩgũcwatĩrĩka.
